🆕 New (Posted: September 21, 2026)

We are holding an autumn walking event through the countryside and villages of the Seimei District: "Sugo-ashi Event – 1st Maple Walk" (name changed from the former "51st Seimei District Walking Rally").

November 23, 2026 (Reiwa 8) — Monday (National Holiday)

【Event Details】
Meeting time: 8:15 a.m. (planned)
Meeting place: Seimei District Administrative Center (planned)
Route: Approximately 8 kilometers, approximately 3 hours (planned)
Fee: Free
What to bring: Drinks, rain gear, Sugo-ashi handbook (if you have one)

【Registration Deadline】
Register by Wednesday, November 11 by contacting either:

• Seimei District Administrative Center: Phone 042-972-2314 | Fax 042-972-9804 | Email seimei-k@city.hanno.lg.jp
• Tamayanagi District Administrative Center: Phone 042-972-9900 | Fax 042-972-9902 | Email nami-k@city.hanno.lg.jp

【Weather-related cancellations】
To check if the event is cancelled due to weather or other conditions, contact the Seimei District Administrative Center between 7:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. on the day of the event.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/13339.html
summary: ℹ️ Sugo-ashi Event: 1st Maple Walk on Monday, November 23, 2026 (National Holiday)
